typical_steps: Check if the problem is a known incident or recently resolved feed issue
Ask the customer for device details and affected network/game
Recommend troubleshooting steps such as device and modem/router reboots, navigating directly to network pages, or using alternate partner apps
Direct the customer to call or chat for 1:1 support if the issue persists
info_agent_requests: Which channel, show, or game is affected
Specific behavior or error message being encountered
when_they_escalate_to_dm: Agents escalate to a direct message, call, or chat when troubleshooting steps fail, when further account/device details need to be collected, or when the user requires personalized 1:1 support.
phrases: For now, try a quick reboot
Call/chat and we'll take a look
never_promises: Unconditional availability of restricted or out-of-market sports content
